findings.message: `token_program.key` supplies the program id for this CPI, and nothing in the handler proves which program it is. An attacker who controls that account can point the invocation at their own program.
findings.snippet: let result = invoke(&ix, &[account, mint, owner, rent, token_program]);
findings.title: unchecked CPI to unknown program
